semanticReview.localChange: Adds explicit separation among migration analysis, debugging, observability, testing, shipping, and host approval; forbids install, CI, production, removal, Git, and deployment side effects without exact authorization.
Replaces the universal claim that code is a liability with a contextual value-versus-carrying-cost test that includes safety, compliance, history, recovery, and compatibility.
Allows a separately authorized safety, legal, or security withdrawal path when like-for-like replacement is impossible, while requiring notice, export, preservation, recovery, and exception handling.
Changes an absolute one-consumer-at-a-time rule into risk-bounded incremental, atomic, or batched migration selected by coupling and consistency constraints.
Keeps the deprecated-surface owner accountable while assigning explicit shared adoption, support, compatibility, and escalation responsibilities to consumer owners.
Makes zero observed usage necessary but insufficient; adds evidence quality, unknown consumers, retention, compliance, rollback, ownership, and explicit approval before ordinary removal.

Permits labeled archival, compatibility, audit, tombstone, and rollback material under an approved retention plan instead of requiring universal deletion of code, tests, documentation, and references.
Retains illustrative Markdown, TypeScript, and an example npx command but ships no executable script, hook, dependency, or tool binding in the Skill directory.

overlapReview.trialTreatment: Expose only this candidate-specific Skill in the treatment arm while keeping shared hard standards identical in both arms.

disposition.attributionLabel: CC Switch-managed local adapted derivative of Addy Osmani deprecation-and-migration at the pinned revision
disposition.reason: The local changes are traceable and materially strengthen authority, unknown-consumer, retention, rollback, and controlled-withdrawal boundaries. The review establishes suitability for a disposable comparison only; it does not establish live exposure or value.
